problems_fixed.what: Audit issue (bad_misconception_message): the wrong_reading message just restated the correct method and gave no diagnostic signal. Rewrote it to name the actual error (reading at the total CF=80 instead of n/2=40), keeping expect=80.
problems_fixed.old: Median = n/2 = 80/2 = 40th value. Reading across from CF = 40 gives a score of exactly 40.
problems_fixed.new: To find the median you must read across from a cumulative frequency of 40, that is n / 2 = 80 / 2 = 40, then down to the score. Reading at a cumulative frequency of 80 (the total) instead lands at the top of the curve and gives the maximum score, not the median.
